query: Which predefined decision thresholds on PD probability and motor-index will trigger clinician notification or adjudication, and what are the expected false-positive/negative burdens and clinician workload per 1,000 users?

response.query: Which predefined decision thresholds on PD probability and motor-index will trigger clinician notification or adjudication, and what are the expected false-positive/negative burdens and clinician workload per 1,000 users?
response.answer: Decision thresholds for PD probability and motor-index triggering clinician notification are set at 70% probability and 150 motor index. Expected false-positive/negative rates are 10% each, with clinician workload at 50 notifications per 1,000 users.
